claims.verified_figure: Defense Ministry Rehabilitation Division: about/over 30,000 wounded IDF soldiers and security personnel admitted to the Division since Oct 7, 2023 (3-year anniversary release, Oct 2026). Population: reservists, conscripts, career soldiers and police (July 2026 breakdown: 62/21/7/10%). ~63% are being treated for psychological injuries, ~37% physical.
claims.article_figure_per_search_snippet: headline: '30 אלף פצועים לכוחות הביטחון'; ynet sibling item: 'מ-7/10: כ-30 אלף נפגעים נקלטו באגף השיקום'
claims.note: Article body unreachable (EGRESS_BLOCKED); judged the headline against the Defense Ministry figures as surfaced in multiple consistent secondary reports. The 30,000 matches. Caveat, not a downgrade: 'wounded' here = admitted to the Rehabilitation Division and includes mental-health injuries (~63%), which is the ministry's own official definition and wording ('פצועים'); a reader could take it to mean physical combat wounds only. The population (IDF + police and other security personnel) matches 'כוחות הביטחון'. The baseline (since Oct 7, 2023) matches.

claims.verified_figure: Defense Ministry Rehabilitation Division (Oct 2026): 8% of security personnel wounded in the past three years are women. Consistent with the July 2026 release (92% men / 8% women of 26,200 war-wounded) and Dec 2025 (9% women, reported against the 82,400 total caseload).
claims.note: Article body unreachable; verdict rests on search-snippet attribution. Checked the risk of a wrong denominator, where the women's share of the Division's total all-wars caseload (91,200) gets attached to the war-wounded cohort. Snippets of the Oct 2026 release (ToI: '8% of security personnel wounded in the past three years are women'; ch10/Hebrew: 'מבין כ-30 אלף הפצועים ... 8% נשים') attribute the 8% to the since-Oct-7 cohort, which matches the headline's 'מהם'. Some snippets phrase it as 'of those seeking treatment', which is ambiguous, but the figure is the same either way.

scope_note: Borderline against the spec's 'official registry / factual tally' exclusion: the outlet mechanically relays a cumulative Defense Ministry release, and both claims match it.
